name: Application
description: Represents the entire Microsoft PowerPoint application.
remarks: The Application object contains: - Application-wide settings and options (the name of the active printer, for example). - Properties that return top-level objects, such as ActivePresentation, and Windows. When you are writing code that will run from PowerPoint, you can use the following properties of the Application object without the object qualifier: ActivePresentation, ActiveWindow, AddIns, Presentations, SlideShowWindows, Windows. For example, instead of writing Application.ActiveWindow.Height = 200, you can write ActiveWindow.Height = 200.
example:
Dim MyPath As String

MyPath = Application.Path

properties.name: Presentations
properties.description: Returns a Presentations collection that represents all open presentations. Read-only.

properties.name: Windows
properties.description: Returns a DocumentWindows collection that represents all open document windows. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveWindow
properties.description: Returns a DocumentWindow object that represents the active document window. Read-only.

properties.name: ActivePresentation
properties.description: Returns a Presentation object that represents the presentation open in the active window. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideShowWindows
properties.description: Returns a SlideShowWindows collection that represents all open slide show windows. Read-only.

properties.name: CommandBars
properties.description: Returns a CommandBars collection that represents all the command bars in Microsoft PowerPoint. Read-only.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the path to the specified Application object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the string "Microsoft PowerPoint." Read-only.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns the text that appears in the title bar of the application window. Read/write.

properties.name: Build
properties.description: Returns the build number for the current instance of Microsoft PowerPoint. Read-only.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft PowerPoint version number. Read-only.

properties.name: OperatingSystem
properties.description: Returns the name of the operating system. Read-only.

properties.name: ActivePrinter
properties.description: Returns the name of the active printer. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIns
properties.description: Returns the program-specific AddIns collection that represents all the add-ins listed in the Add-Ins dialog box (click the Office button, click PowerPoint Options, click Add-Ins, click PowerPoint Add-Ins on the Manage list). Read-only.

properties.name: VBE
properties.description: Returns a VBE object that represents the Visual Basic Editor. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the distance in points from the left edge of the document, application, and slide show windows to the left edge of the application window's client area. Setting this property to a very large positive or negative value may position the window completely off the desktop. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the distance in points from the top edge of the document, application, and slide show window to the top edge of the application window's client area. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the specified object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the specified window. Read/write.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a MsoTriState value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: Returns whether the specified pane or window is active. Read-only.

properties.name: COMAddIns
properties.description: Returns a reference to the Component Object Model (COM) add-ins currently loaded in Microsoft PowerPoint. These add-ins are listed on the Add-Ins tab in the PowerPoint Options dialog box. Read-only.

properties.name: ProductCode
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft PowerPoint globally unique identifier (GUID). Read-only.

properties.name: LanguageSettings
properties.description: Returns a LanguageSettings object that contains information about the language settings in Microsoft PowerPoint. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowWindowsInTaskbar
properties.description: Determines whether there is a separate Windows taskbar button for each open presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: FeatureInstall
properties.description: Returns or sets how Microsoft PowerPoint handles calls to methods and properties that require features not yet installed. Read/write.

properties.name: FileDialog
properties.description: Returns a FileDialog object that represents a single instance of a file dialog box. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayGridLines
properties.description: Determines whether to display gridlines in Microsoft PowerPoint. Read/write.

properties.name: AutomationSecurity
properties.description: Represents the security mode that Microsoft PowerPoint uses when it opens files programmatically. Read/write.

properties.name: NewPresentation
properties.description: Returns a NewFile object that represents a presentation listed on the New Presentation task pane. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayAlerts
properties.description: Sets or returns whether Microsoft PowerPoint displays alerts while running a macro. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowStartupDialog
properties.description: Determines whether to display the New Presentation task pane when Microsoft PowerPoint is started. Read/write.

properties.name: AutoCorrect
properties.description: Returns an AutoCorrect object that represents the AutoCorrect functionality in Microsoft PowerPoint.

properties.name: Options
properties.description: Returns an Options object that represents application options in Microsoft PowerPoint.

properties.name: DisplayDocumentInformationPanel
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the Document Properties panel is displayed in the Microsoft PowerPoint user interface. Read/write.

properties.name: Assistance
properties.description: Gets a reference to the Microsoft Office IAssistance object, which provides a means for developers to create a customized help experience for users within Microsoft Office. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveEncryptionSession
properties.description: Represents the encryption session associated with the active presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: FileConverters
properties.description: Returns information about installed file converters. Returns null if there are no converters installed. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: SmartArtLayouts
properties.description: Returns the SmartArt layout of the current Application object. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartArtQuickStyles
properties.description: Returns the quick styles of the SmartArt diagram in the current Application object. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartArtColors
properties.description: Returns the SmartArt colors of the current Application object. Read-only.

properties.name: ProtectedViewWindows
properties.description: Returns a ProtectedViewWindows collection that represents all the Protected View windows that are open in the application. Read-only

properties.name: ActiveProtectedViewWindow
properties.description: Returns a ProtectedViewWindow object that represents the active Protected View window (the window on top). Read-only.

properties.name: IsSandboxed
properties.description: Returns True if the specified presentation is open in a Protected View window. Read-only.

properties.name: FileValidation
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates how PowerPoint will validate files before opening them. Read/write

properties.name: ChartDataPointTrack
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that specifies whether charts use cell-reference data-point tracking. Read/write.

properties.name: DisplayGuides
properties.description: Gets or sets whether drawing guides are displayed in the application.

properties.name: SensitivityLabelPolicy
properties.description: Returns the SensitivityLabelPolicy object.

parameters.name: HelpFile
parameters.description: The name of the Help file you want to display. Can be either a .chm or an .hlp file. If this argument is not specified, Microsoft PowerPoint Help is used.

parameters.name: ContextID
parameters.description: The context ID number for the Help topic. If this argument is not specified or if it specifies a context ID number that is not associated with a Help topic, the Help Topics dialog box is displayed.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Quits Microsoft PowerPoint. This is equivalent to clicking the Office button and then clicking Exit PowerPoint.

methods.name: Run
methods.signature: Run(MacroName As String, safeArrayOfParams As SAFEARRAY(Variant)) As Variant

parameters.name: MacroName
parameters.description: The name of the procedure to be run. The string can contain the following: a loaded presentation or add-in file name followed by an exclamation point (!), a valid module name followed by a period (.), and the procedure name. For example, the following is a valid MacroName value: "MyPres.pptm!Module1.Test."

methods.name: StartNewUndoEntry
methods.description: Starts a new undo entry in the Application object.

events.name: WindowSelectionChange
events.description: Occurs when the selection of text, a shape, or a slide in the active document window changes, whether in the user interface or in code.

parameters.name: Sel
parameters.description: Represents the object selected.

events.name: WindowBeforeRightClick
events.signature: WindowBeforeRightClick(Sel As Selection, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when you right-click a shape, a slide, a notes page, or some text. This event is triggered by the MouseUp event.

parameters.name: Sel
parameters.description: The selection below the mouse pointer when the right-click occurred.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the default context menu does not appear when the procedure is finished.

events.name: WindowBeforeDoubleClick
events.signature: WindowBeforeDoubleClick(Sel As Selection, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when you double-click the items in the views listed in the following table.

parameters.name: Sel
parameters.description: The selection below the mouse pointer when the double-click occurs.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the default double-click action isn't performed when the procedure is finished.

events.name: PresentationClose
events.description: Occurs immediately before any open presentation closes, as it is removed from the Presentations collection.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation that is being closed.

events.name: PresentationSave
events.description: Occurs before any open presentation is saved.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation to be saved.

events.name: PresentationOpen
events.description: Occurs after an existing presentation is opened, as it is added to the Presentations collection.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation that is opened.

events.name: NewPresentation
events.description: Occurs after a presentation is created, as it is added to the Presentations collection.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The new presentation.

events.name: PresentationNewSlide
events.description: Occurs when a new slide is created in any open presentation, as the slide is added to the Slides collection.

parameters.name: Sld
parameters.description: The new slide.

events.name: WindowActivate
events.signature: WindowActivate(Pres As Presentation, Wn As DocumentWindow)
events.description: Occurs when the application window or any document window is activated.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation displayed in the activated window.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The activated document window.

events.name: WindowDeactivate
events.signature: WindowDeactivate(Pres As Presentation, Wn As DocumentWindow)
events.description: Occurs when the application window or any document window is deactivated.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation displayed in the deactivated window.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The deactivated document window.

events.name: SlideShowBegin
events.description: Occurs when you start a slide show.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The slide show window initialized prior to this event.

events.name: SlideShowNextBuild
events.description: Occurs upon mouse-click or timing animation, but before the animated object becomes visible. .

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The active slide show window.

events.name: SlideShowNextSlide
events.description: Occurs immediately before the transition to the next slide. For the first slide, occurs immediately after the SlideShowBegin event.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The active slide show window.

events.name: SlideShowEnd
events.description: Occurs after a slide show ends, immediately after the last SlideShowNextSlide event occurs.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation closed when this event occurs.

events.name: PresentationPrint
events.description: Occurs before a presentation is printed.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation to be printed.

events.name: SlideSelectionChanged
events.description: Occurs at different times depending on the current view.

parameters.name: SldRange
parameters.description: The selection of slides. In most cases this would be a single slide (for example, in Slide View you navigate to the next slide), but in some cases this could be multiple slides (for example, a marquee selection in Slide Sorter View).

events.name: ColorSchemeChanged
events.description: Occurs after a color scheme is changed.

parameters.name: SldRange
parameters.description: The range of slides affected by the change.

events.name: PresentationBeforeSave
events.signature: PresentationBeforeSave(Pres As Presentation, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs before a presentation is saved.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation being saved.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: True to cancel the save process.

events.name: SlideShowNextClick
events.signature: SlideShowNextClick(Wn As SlideShowWindow, nEffect As Effect)
events.description: Occurs on the next click of the slide.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The slide show window initialized prior to this event.

parameters.name: nEffect
parameters.description: The effect to animate on next click.

events.name: AfterNewPresentation
events.description: Occurs after a presentation is created.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: Name of the presentation.

events.name: AfterPresentationOpen
events.description: Occurs after an existing presentation is opened.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation that is opened.

events.name: PresentationSync
events.signature: PresentationSync(Pres As Presentation, SyncEventType As MsoSyncEventType)
events.description: Occurs when the local copy of a presentation that is part of a Document Workspace is synchronized with the copy on the server. Provides important status information regarding the success or failure of the synchronization of the presentation.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The presentation that is being synchronized.

parameters.name: SyncEventType
parameters.description: The status of the synchronization.

events.name: SlideShowOnNext
events.description: Occurs when the user clicks Next to move within the current slide.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The active slideshow window.

events.name: SlideShowOnPrevious
events.description: Occurs when the user clicks Previous to move within the current slide.

parameters.name: Wn
parameters.description: The active slideshow window.

events.name: PresentationBeforeClose
events.signature: PresentationBeforeClose(Pres As Presentation, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Represents a Presentation object before it closes.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The Presentation object.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: If set to True, the presentation will not close.

events.name: ProtectedViewWindowOpen
events.description: Occurs when a Protected View window is opened.

parameters.name: ProtViewWindow
parameters.description: The Protected View window that is opened.

events.name: ProtectedViewWindowBeforeEdit
events.description: Occurs immediately before editing is enabled on the document in the specified Protected View window.

parameters.name: ProtViewWindow
parameters.description: The Protected View window that contains the document that is enabled for editing.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, editing is not enabled on the document.

events.name: ProtectedViewWindowBeforeClose
events.signature: ProtectedViewWindowBeforeClose(ProtViewWindow As ProtectedViewWindow, ProtectedViewCloseReason As PpProtectedViewCloseReason, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs immediately before a Protected View window or a document in a Protected View window closes.

parameters.name: ProtViewWindow
parameters.description: The Protected View window that is closed.

parameters.name: ProtectedViewCloseReason
parameters.description: A constant that specifies the reason the Protected View window is closed.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the window does not close when the procedure is finished.

events.name: ProtectedViewWindowActivate
events.description: Occurs when any Protected View window is activated.

parameters.name: ProtViewWindow
parameters.description: The Protected View window that is activated.

events.name: ProtectedViewWindowDeactivate
events.description: Occurs when a Protected View window is deactivated.

parameters.name: ProtViewWindow
parameters.description: The deactivated Protected View window.

events.name: PresentationCloseFinal
events.description: Represents closing the final Presentation object.

parameters.name: Pres
parameters.description: The Presentation object.

events.name: AfterDragDropOnSlide
events.signature: AfterDragDropOnSlide(Sld As Slide, X As Single, Y As Single)
events.description: Occurs after an object with the clipboard format "PowerPoint Drop Trigger" has been dropped onto a slide in an open presentation.

parameters.name: Sld
parameters.description: The slide that raised the event (that is, had a shape added to it).

events.name: AfterShapeSizeChange
events.description: Occurs after an object (shape, picture, text box, chart, SmartArt as examples) has been resized on the slide.

parameters.name: shp
parameters.description: The shape that was resized.
